thread:
morgan: Heads-up — postmortem follow-up for the metering delay on 2026-03-18. Root cause looks like a delayed Kafka consumer causing a cascading ledger backfill that inflated token counts and delayed invoices. Need owners + timelines.

kai: thanks. can we split remediation into 3 owners? short-term fix, billing credits, and monitoring.

asha: I can own billing credits & invoice adjustments. I'll draft roll-forward credits and a reconciliation plan. target EOD Wed (2026-03-25).

jules: I'll take the short-term patch to the consumer batching logic and add a protection to drop duplicate ingest when backlog > 2M tokens. ETA Mon (2026-03-23).

samir: i'll add a canary for consumer lag and export a gauge to Datadog. need infra perms to rotate the API key.

ellie-fin: For finance we need a sample CSV of affected invoices and a reason code. @asha i'll attach the list in MET ticket when ready.

billing-bot: Ticket created: MET-5243 "Ledger drain/backfill causing delayed usage" — assignees: jules,kai,asha — due: 2026-03-28

kai: here's a quick query to pull suspect rows if anyone needs it:

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, token_count, inserted_at
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE inserted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-17' AND '2026-03-19'
AND source = 'metering-consumer'
ORDER BY inserted_at DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

asha: thanks — once I get the list I'll propose credits and a customer email template.
